text: Rubem Fonseca's Feliz Ano Novo was censored in Brazil under the military regime. A letter of 6 December to the minister of Justice said the book contained material offensive to morality and good customs. It remained censored until 1985. After the dictatorship ended in 1985, the author waited four more years of court battle; after he won in court in 1989, the book was republished that year.
meta_description: Feliz Ano Novo by Rubem Fonseca was censored in Brazil under the military regime and republished in 1989 after the author won in court.
